reviews.title: Joe
reviews.text:
Not what I expected. 

I want a basic radio app. Easy to use like a desktop/kitchen table radio. Search station call sign option, obviously. But a location based GUI Tuner knob. This connected to an old fashioned slide scale graphic and digital number readout.  Volume and balance controls. A few techy tuning options if possible. Last and VERY IMPORTANTLY, a power off button always visible on the screen. Why? All of us need a shutoff button for EVERY APP.

I auditioned 5 radio apps recently and NONE HAD AN EASY WAY TO SHUT THEM DOWN!!!  I recently was in traffic and needed to shut off the radio. I swiped 4 ways and double tapped the screen but every one of them was oblivious to my inputs. Why is there not an OBVIOUS button to turn off the program???

I finally had to turn off the phone to stop the audio. Later tried this issue on the other 4 I was trying and NONE HAD SN EASY OFF ON SCREEN. 

So I must rate none of any radio apps trying to this minute better than 3 stars.

reviews.title: When somebody reports a station outage, it sure seems like you should try and fix it quicker
reviews.text:
I listen to Indiana University sports on Simple Radio. Have been doing it for years. It has always worked fairly well. Unfortunately on January 1, 2025 the station I listen to was not connected to Simple Radio. That happened to be the day of the Rose Bowl, where Indiana was playing Alabama. I started reporting the outage early in the morning and nothing happened. It would’ve been great to at least receive a error message that wasn’t quite so generic. The annual subscription for this app is dirt cheap. Maybe consider charging a little bit more and and hire a person to ensure that reported outages are at least responded to in a timely manner.

Otherwise, thank you for a super app that normally is very enjoyable and useful.

reviews.title: Scam advertisements
reviews.text: After years of occasionally using this app to listen to local radio stations, it has suddenly developed several problems. First, every time I try to go to a local NPR station, it states that the station is not available. This problem has persisted for over a week. More concerning, the app now posts full page scam advertisements announcing that my iPhone memory is full and that I must do something NOW to fix it. This is a classic malware deception. The first time it happened, I assumed something had gone wrong. The second time it happened, I realized that this is probably paid advertising. I am very disappointed that this app allows such ads. I have deleted the app from my phone. Use caution if you decide to try this app.
